# A32 — agent trace could not prove which execution backend ran a terminal command

**Section**: A. CI & build pipeline
**Keywords**: agent, agenttool.backendlabel, backend, build, command, execution, local, marker, observability, observations, output, pipeline, prefixes, prove, terminaltool, termux, trace

## Problem

agent trace could not prove which execution backend ran a terminal command

## Root cause

TerminalTool output had no backend marker

## Solution

AgentTool.backendLabel (termux/local) + TerminalTool prefixes observations with [termux]/[local]
